package handler

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

// 两个严格 WAL 崩溃点：第二关只有一人投票，以及通关后仅第一人领奖。
// 恢复必须保留路线种子/已投票与两实体领奖事实；第三个进程仍只有各 10 金币。
func TestCoopRoguelikeRealCrashRecovery(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("ROOST_COOP_ROGUELIKE_REAL") != "1" {
		t.Skip("ROOST_COOP_ROGUELIKE_REAL not set")
	}
	if os.Getenv("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_MONGO_URI") == "" {
		t.Fatal("private Mongo replica set required")
	}

	verify := func(t *testing.T, h *sessionRuntime) {
		s := h.state(t)
		if s.Stage != 3 || s.Seed != 8129822322734983565 || !s.Cleared || s.Claimed != [2]bool{true, true} || s.Votes != [2]int{-1, -1} || s.Revision != 8 || h.coins(t) != [2]int64{10, 10} {
			t.Fatalf("cooperative terminal/rewards: %+v coins=%v", s, h.coins(t))
		}
		for i := range h.players {
			h.refuse(t, i, h.command(t, i, "claim", 0))
			h.refuse(t, i, h.command(t, i, "vote", 0))
		}
		h.replayLast(t)
	}
	finish := func(t *testing.T, h *sessionRuntime) {
		for !h.state(t).Cleared {
			for i := range h.players {
				if h.state(t).Votes[i] < 0 {
					h.act(t, i, "vote", i)
				}
			}
		}
		for i := range h.players {
			if !h.state(t).Claimed[i] {
				if got := h.act(t, i, "claim", 0); got.Reward != 10 {
					t.Fatal("missing reward", got)
				}
			}
			h.replayLast(t)
		}
	}
	runSessionCrash(t, []sessionCrashCase{
		{name: "partial_vote", seed: func(t *testing.T, h *sessionRuntime) {
			h.act(t, 0, "vote", 0)
			h.act(t, 1, "vote", 1)
			h.act(t, 0, "vote", 0)
			s := h.state(t)
			if s.Stage != 1 || s.Votes != [2]int{0, -1} || s.Revision != 3 || s.Seed == 12345 {
				t.Fatal("wrong partial-vote crash state", s)
			}
			h.refuse(t, 0, h.command(t, 0, "vote", 0))
			h.refuse(t, 1, h.command(t, 1, "claim", 0))
		}, recover: func(t *testing.T, h *sessionRuntime) {
			s := h.state(t)
			if s.Stage != 1 || s.Votes != [2]int{0, -1} || h.coins(t) != [2]int64{} {
				t.Fatal("partial vote/rewards changed", s)
			}
			finish(t, h)
		}, verify: verify},
		{name: "first_reward", seed: func(t *testing.T, h *sessionRuntime) {
			for range 3 {
				h.act(t, 0, "vote", 0)
				h.act(t, 1, "vote", 1)
			}
			h.act(t, 0, "claim", 0)
			s := h.state(t)
			if !s.Cleared || s.Claimed != [2]bool{true, false} || s.Revision != 7 || h.coins(t) != [2]int64{10, 0} {
				t.Fatal("wrong reward crash state", s)
			}
		}, recover: func(t *testing.T, h *sessionRuntime) {
			if s := h.state(t); s.Claimed != [2]bool{true, false} || h.coins(t) != [2]int64{10, 0} {
				t.Fatal("acknowledged reward was lost or doubled", s)
			}
			finish(t, h)
		}, verify: verify},
	})
}
